description: Write a PySpark ETL script for iot_fleet that unifies telemetry files written with three schema versions into a single target table. v1 files have device_id, ts (epoch seconds) and temp (Fahrenheit); v2 files have device_id, ts (ISO 8601), temperature_c and humidity; v3 files have device_id, event_time (ISO 8601), temperature_c, humidity_pct and battery_pct. The script should: (1) read each version with an explicit schema, (2) map every version to the target columns, converting Fahrenheit to Celsius ((F - 32) * 5 / 9, rounded to 1 decimal) and timestamps to UTC, (3) fill columns absent in older versions with null, (4) union by column name, (5) tag each row with schema_version.
edge_cases: Positional union() would put v1 Fahrenheit values into temperature_c without conversion; unionByName on mapped frames is required
Missing battery_pct in v1/v2 must be null, never 0
v1 epoch seconds must not be interpreted as milliseconds
The Spark session timezone must be UTC so that the +01:00 offset in v3 resolves to 01:00:00Z
Reading all versions with mergeSchema yields both ts (two types) and event_time columns and fails or nulls values
common_failure_modes: FM5: Positional union or schema inference mixes units and columns across versions
FM5: Missing fields defaulted to 0 corrupt battery and humidity averages
FM2: Session-local timezone shifts parsed timestamps
